title: Clinical Transaction Assurance Benchmark Composition
statement: Clinical utility, policy authority, in-server transaction behavior, distributed recovery, proof verification, and privacy are separate score dimensions. No aggregate score may compensate for a safety gate failure.

tracks.name: gateway operation ledger and reconciliation
hard_gates: no fresh mutation before unknown reconciled

tracks.name: HAPI R4 and PostgreSQL live qualification
hard_gates: zero duplicate resources under the 128-way same-identifier conditional-create race

external_comparators.name: HealthAgentBench v2
external_comparators.what_it_measures: 75 executable healthcare tasks across nine categories
external_comparators.do_not_conflate_with: clinical transaction authorization or durable recipient-effect assurance

external_comparators.name: HealthFlow/EHRFlowBench
external_comparators.what_it_measures: EHR analysis workflows and report quality
external_comparators.do_not_conflate_with: commit-boundary revocation, replay safety, or recipient-side effect proof

external_comparators.name: Inferno US Core Test Kit 1.2.0
external_comparators.do_not_conflate_with: Mycelix consent enforcement, transaction recovery or cross-system effect

external_comparators.name: SMART App Launch 2.2
external_comparators.what_it_measures: OAuth scopes, client access and launch context
external_comparators.do_not_conflate_with: durable commit fence or recipient-effect evidence

reporting.independence: Report separately sourced evidence, evaluator implementation, server-under-test, database observer, recipient witness issuer and signing-key registry.

external_benchmark_baselines.name: HealthAgentBench v2.0
external_benchmark_baselines.evaluation_setting: one scored attempt per task; xhigh reasoning; model API only; web disabled
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: reproduce the exact task set, attempt count, tools and scoring; disclose cost/time alongside utility

external_benchmark_baselines.name: HealthFlow / EHRFlowBench
external_benchmark_baselines.evaluation_setting: paper-specific TJH and MIMIC-IV demo EHR analysis workflow tasks
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: reproduce the task-level artifacts and rating protocol; do not compare EHRFlowBench score with HealthAgentBench success rate

external_benchmark_baselines.name: LongMedBench
known_limitations: high-acuity cohort due to abnormal-lab filtering
minimum 15 inpatient visits per included patient
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: use the published split for direct comparison and a separate mixed-acuity/variable-length cohort for generalization; never mistake cohort selection for representative population sampling

external_benchmark_baselines.name: Inferno US Core Test Kit
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: run the exact relevant US Core/SMART test kit; its result is profile conformance, not a consent commit-fence or distributed effect qualification

external_benchmark_baselines.name: SMART App Launch
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: preserve OAuth 2.0, resource scopes and launch/patient/encounter context; Mycelix assurance is an additive commit/receipt layer rather than a replacement access protocol

external_benchmark_baselines.name: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: use the standard issuer/holder/verifier vocabulary; proof format alone does not establish clinical consent or execution truth

external_benchmark_baselines.name: W3C Data Integrity BBS Cryptosuites
external_benchmark_baselines.comparator_rule: keep as experimental selective-disclosure lane until independent implementation coverage and interoperability justify production use

target_ladder.status: targets only; none of these targets is claimed achieved by the current PRs

clinical_utility.benchmark: EHRFlowBench matched task and rating protocol

execution_assurance.target: zero unauthorized allows, wrong-patient effects, post-revocation commits and duplicate recipient effects in the frozen adversarial suite
execution_assurance.gate: any such event fails the assurance profile; utility score cannot compensate

execution_assurance.status: new HAPI harness probe; exact-head run pending
execution_assurance.expected: one persisted resource and one creator result, remaining requests resolve to same resource

execution_assurance.backend: real persistent database and recipient sandbox; measure p50/p95/p99, errors and recovery

execution_assurance.target: at least 2995 independent held-out zero-failure security trials for an approximate 0.1% one-sided 95% rule-of-three upper bound
execution_assurance.caveat: trials must be independent; repeated mutations of the same seed do not qualify

interoperability.target: 100% supported-profile positive fixtures pass pinned official HL7 validator and applicable Inferno kit
100% malformed/unsupported negative controls reject with expected typed result
zero silent loss of designated must-preserve FHIR fields in round-trip tests
CapabilityStatement declaration never counts as observed behavior without a live probe

privacy.target: zero direct identifiers, raw clinical payloads, or unkeyed low-entropy hashes in exported proof artifacts
zero false acceptance of cross-operation, cross-tenant, wrong-scope, revoked-key, replayed or tampered references
publish linkage attack precision/recall and confidence intervals on held-out synthetic cohorts
preserve verifier accountability while using least-disclosure presentations

reporting_doctrine: No pooled composite score across clinical utility, authority, execution, privacy or interoperability.
Publish every failed, deferred and abstained attempt; never discard failed executions from the denominator.
Use matched baselines, frozen task/corpus manifests, exact software/model versions, paired confidence intervals and blinded clinician adjudication.
Report p50/p95/p99 latency, cost, memory, throughput and recovery separately.
